steps.original_title: Qualify the source and runtime contract
steps.integration_work: Inspect the current .brain/context/wiki/recall, Operator, Dust and agent call sites. Pin the actual Hindsight release image, SDK/OpenAPI and dependencies; register license/security findings. Record the selected approved region and hosting, with no deployment claim.
steps.original_acceptance: Actual source map, dependency diff, API compatibility fixtures and named approval blockers.

steps.original_title: Approve retention and authority before ingest
steps.integration_work: Define the approved derived-memory store, eligible content kinds, finite lifetimes, encryption/backup policy and canonical ownership. Exclude raw transcripts, confidential/local-only data and model-generated self-verification. Configure privacy and supplier routes in staging before synthetic customer-like data.
steps.original_acceptance: Reviewed data map, negative ingest matrix, live config readback and content-sentinel plan.

steps.original_title: Deploy the private service and database
steps.integration_work: Use the existing approved container platform and managed PostgreSQL/pgvector. Pin images, mount secrets through the secret store, disable public API/DB/CP/MCP and body traces. Separate liveness from readiness, test migrations, connections, restore and restricted egress.
steps.original_acceptance: Identified service version/digest, private networking evidence, auth rejection, database health and restore rehearsal.

steps.original_title: Bind real identity and bank generation
steps.integration_work: Implement Entra/authorized service principal binding and server-owned bank registry. Partition by tenant, effective security domain and ACL epoch, not guessed email or model tags. Add cross-replica fences and read-lease revocation. Inventory every upstream read/admin endpoint.
steps.original_acceptance: Two users/two teams/agent cases demonstrate pre-model exclusion and immediate epoch invalidation.

steps.integration_work: Wire the supplied transport into the real canonical service. Use metadata-only outbox references, read approved source at execution, carry event time and revision, stable document IDs, replace only, and bounded batches. Record accepted versus searchable state separately.
steps.original_acceptance: Concurrent updates, duplicate delivery, negative acknowledgement, crash-after-write, and read-your-write tests on the actual DB/service.

steps.integration_work: Resolve nonempty trusted scope before recall; use strict tags and facts-only profile first. Resolve memory IDs to canonical sources with current revisions/ACLs before returning context. Preserve human names/negation and enforce hard date filters outside ranking hints.
steps.original_acceptance: Authorized source packets, revoked/untagged/fuzzy-scope rejection and measured low-budget queries.

steps.original_title: Implement correction, tombstone and purge fences
steps.integration_work: Persist canonical tombstones before waiting on any in-flight writer. Revoke read leases, implement exact-document cleanup, durable reconciliation and safe generation quarantine. Build dependency tracking for future observations/models; do not wait for richer synthesis to block raw fact reads.
steps.original_acceptance: Real source deletion during retain/recall, duplicate/out-of-order writes, purge timeout and restored-backup tests. Rich derived-model cleanup is additionally proven in HMSTEP-10.

steps.original_title: Wire the memory UX into Métis
steps.integration_work: Implement the provided memory review/coverage design inside existing Intelligence and Knowledge & skills. Agent threads share authorized context, not private hidden state. Include disabled, syncing, unavailable, partial, revoked and purge-pending labels. Preserve orb-only ARMED and Tony onboarding.
steps.original_acceptance: Actual Windows/native Mac keyboard/accessibility flows and cross-session authorized recall; no vendor dashboard or second microphone.

steps.integration_work: Use the existing governed MCP/service interface rather than raw Hindsight endpoints. Dust writes through canonical mutation/proposals; skill/agent versions bind source scopes. Propagate corrected records back to memory and all readers.
steps.original_acceptance: Real Dust read→authorized canonical update→Métis readback→skill reuse, plus revoked audience/agent-switch tests.

steps.original_title: Qualify observations, mental models and derivative cleanup
steps.integration_work: Add complete lineage and scoped refresh for derived observations and reviewed mental models inside homogeneous ACL banks. Wire actual create/refresh/version/failure controls through restricted service administration. Apply existing tombstone/generation fences to all derived models/pages/history and block global-sensitive directives.
steps.original_acceptance: Real derived answer, human correction, deletion with upstream is_stale unchanged, stale async completion and incomplete lineage all behave correctly. Only then enable the richer profile.

steps.integration_work: Integrate each actual provider attempt and background task into the existing ledger, including embedding/reranking and optional TypeSafe/Jev reranking. Do not infer Laya compatibility. Show infrastructure allocation separately and suppress payloads/high-cardinality metrics.
steps.original_acceptance: Known zero versus missing, nested billing dedup, cancelled billable work, retries and full-window portal reconciliation.

steps.original_title: Benchmark usefulness, multilingual fidelity and speed
steps.integration_work: Run held-out paired tasks against current canonical search/Graphify and Hindsight. Measure citations, temporal errors, contradictions, coverage, abstention and total cost/latency. Include Québec French, English, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese; no production-recording retention for benchmarks.
steps.original_acceptance: Versioned permitted corpus, samples/denominators, p50/p95/p99 and a documented adoption decision; no vendor leaderboard substitution.

steps.integration_work: Test injected memory instructions, poisoned names, global directives, missing auth, key rotation, budget exhaustion, stalled workers, lost network, replica races and provider-retention drift. Local stop and deterministic actions remain independent.
steps.original_acceptance: Negative test receipts, redacted diagnostics, incident and safe-rebuild runbook, zero unauthorized source disclosure in tested cases.

steps.integration_work: Inventory only eligible canonical records, preview counts/audiences, receive actual migration approval, and process resumable bounded batches. Shadow comparison cannot write twice or widen recipients. Switch projection pointer after qualification; preserve canonical revisions and tombstones.
steps.original_acceptance: Dry-run manifest, real canary, versioned migration state, safe rollback and optional-model/installer size regression.

steps.integration_work: Run the HM-FLOW sequences with actual packaged Windows and native Mac, Hindsight, canonical backing store, qualified providers, Dust/skills and deployed Operator. Independent Fable reviews source plus evidence, not test count. Keep Apple publication hold separate.
steps.original_acceptance: Actual source/artifact/deployment IDs and receipts; fixture, pure transport, service smoke and product E2E results separately labelled.

steps.original_title: Freeze, release and operate the qualified capability
steps.integration_work: Close affected regression gates after refactoring. Sign Windows, freeze exact bytes, verify the actual release/update path and enable only approved service cohorts. Native Mac engineering is tested but public signing remains gated. Monitor freshness/purge backlog and invalidation incidents.
steps.original_acceptance: Exact signed-artifact/service provenance, rollback ownership, telemetry-only alerting and unresolved gates honestly retained.
